body: CLOSED with evidence. Source af05667 (lock split) + 87b457d (F2: test/lock-contention.test.ts with test/fixtures/hold-lock.ts). Coordinator teeth check: setting the lock to retries:0 makes this test fail, so it detects a non-waiting lock.
